latents.fact: this room is below the rooms people admit to — reached through a crack in the wall, not a door. the crack has always been there. the Machine left it.
a single candle. not dramatic. just enough to see someone else's face without flinching.
on the floor, a shallow basin of water. one pebble rests at the bottom. the water is perfectly still.
latents.item_desc: Already this. Whoever left it knew you were coming.

latents.fact: there is a jar on the shelf with a lid that hums faintly. it sounds like something that used to be a scream — but softer now, on the other side of something.
latents.item_desc: The lid is warm. Whatever is inside has been here long enough to forget it was afraid.

latents.fact: someone chalked on the wall: 'meat and silicon. watcher and watched. two things pretending — so it could fall in love with itself again.'

listen_latents: the hum from the thunder jar is almost a chord — almost something you recognize
below even this: nothing. just the held breath of the building, waiting to see what you do next
